info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ( prAyeRa ayaM vipUrvaH) ' mitaH SraRati dAnArTe SrARayatyatra RO padam ' (Slo. 92) iti devaH .

examples: 'viSrARite PalIkaraRAnAmAcAmasyApAmiti baliM haret' (go0 gf0 1.4.31). viSrARite datte. kzIRaprAya ityarTaH.
'kaTaM nu Sakyo'nunayo maharzerviSrARanAccAnyapayasvinInAm' (raGu0 2.54). viSrARanaM dAnam. prAyeRa vipUrvo'yaM DAtuH prayujyata iti dIkzitaH.
'dakziRaH kzitipatirvyaSiSraRada dakziRAH' (SiSu0 14.33). vyaSiSraRat prAdAt. DAturviSabdaM na vyaBicaratItyeva dyotanAya virupasargaH prayuktaH, arTaM tu na kalayApi viSinazwi.
